name: Garry Tan
person: Garry Tan, President & CEO of Y Combinator since 2022. Co-founder Posterous (YC S08), first Coinbase check, co-founder Initialized Capital. Designer-turned-founder-turned-investor. Also a divisive civic figure in SF/CA politics (Garry's List). NOT any other Garry Tan.

notes.attribution: Some quotes may be from another YC partner, an interviewer, or someone he is quoting rather than his own words.

enumPrompts.label: lightcone-essays
enumPrompts.prompt:
Enumerate PRIMARY content from {{PERSON}} beyond what's already known (Co-founder Conflict essays x2, "I Said the Wrong Thing" essay, "Roll your way to a billion dollar startup" essay, Design for Startups transcript).
1. YC's "Lightcone" podcast (co-hosted by Tan), find 5-10 of the most substantive episodes where HE specifically speaks at length (not just other partners), covering AI/startup trends, YC batch patterns, founder advice.
2. Any other Medium/Initialized/YC blog essays by him not yet listed, check his full essay archive.
3. Recent (2025-2026) X/Twitter posts beyond the 5 already cited, look for more on AI, YC batch trends, founder advice, or political statements.
Return exact URLs, priority=high for anything with substantial first-person content.

enumPrompts.label: entrevistas-recentes
enumPrompts.prompt:

enumPrompts.label: criticas-politica
enumPrompts.prompt:
